payload.title: Generate and manage image candidates through a shared provider interface
payload.description:
As an editor or agent, I want Papyrus to generate and select editorial image candidates so that I can use the same process across clients.

Feature: Generated image candidates
  Scenario: Generate candidate images
    Given an authorized editor has an image brief and a configured generation provider
    When they request a round of images
    Then Papyrus returns up to four distinguishable candidates
    And records the provider, actual model, prompt and generation time where available
  Scenario: Apply a generated image
    Given a generated candidate is available
    When the editor applies it to a Story or Reference
    Then Papyrus stores it using the supported media workflow with accessible description and generation provenance
  Scenario: No provider configured
    Given no image generation provider is configured
    When image generation is requested
    Then Papyrus explains how to configure it and does not silently invoke a paid provider

Model/provider selection is tracked by PPY-f0af42 and requires the previously recorded owner decision; support explicit provider configuration and honest provenance. User selection, an agent's draft choice, and replacing an image should work without pretending a person approved it.
